title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 1. Reasserts the universality, interdependence, interrelatedness and indivisibility of human rights and the inherent dignity of every human being; reaffirms the duty of the EU and its Member States to promote and protect democracy and fundamental freedoms worldwide; emphasises that the EU and its institutions must lead by example by respecting national sovereignty, ensuring true democratic principles within their own structures, and avoiding double standards in the application of human rights and international justice;
